quest_001.title: Talk to the Old Man
quest_001.summary: Find the Old Man in his cozy wood cabin.
quest_001.objective: Talk to the Old Man in his cabin.
quest_001.nextStep: Go to the cabin (Room 003) and speak with the Old Man. His cabin is to the southwest of the Grassy Field Crossroads.

quest_002.title: A Flower for my Wife
quest_002.summary: The Old Man sure is romantic. Help him pick a flower for his wife.
quest_002.objective: Bring a Yellow Flower to the Old Man.
quest_002.nextStep: Find a Yellow Flower in the flower patch to the north, then return to the Old Man in Room his cabin.

quest_003.title: Talk to the Young Soldier
quest_003.summary: A young soldier nearby looks like they have advice.
quest_003.objective: Talk to the Young Soldier in Room 003c.
quest_003.nextStep: Go to Room 003c and talk to the Young Soldier.

quest_004.title: Equip a Weapon
quest_004.summary: The soldier insists you should arm yourself.
quest_004.objective: Equip any item in your Main Hand (not fists).
quest_004.nextStep: Open Inventory and equip something into Main Hand.
